EASY TO EXPLAIN

Every signal has a simple rule.

Kola compares one video frame with the next, finds the center and direction of movement, checks whether it left your custom drawn shape, and waits long enough to avoid one-frame alarms.

changes between framescenter of movementcustom drawn zoneswaits before alertingnumbers-only sync
!

Caregiver aid, not a medical device

Kola does not identify a baby, infer emotion, monitor breathing, prevent SIDS, or replace direct supervision. Motion can come from caregivers, bedding, lighting, or the camera itself.
